summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend E2E testing for Kuvira Sports MVP. Backend: 30/30 pytest tests passed (100%) covering auth OTP flow, onboarding, sports/facilities/availability, bookings, games list/create/join, players match_score sorting, coaches/events/tournaments+register, community posts+like toggle, marketplace products/recommend/cart/orders, AI Coach chat (Claude Sonnet 4.6 replied ~800 chars), history, insights, recommendations, and search. Frontend E2E: login → OTP 123456 → 4-step onboarding → Home. Verified all 5 tabs (Home, Discover, Play, Community, Profile) load. Verified booking flow (facility → date → court → slot → Confirm & Pay → confirmation), marketplace (product → Add to Cart → Buy Now → checkout → order confirmed), AI Coach chat (Claude reply received in-app), community post creation + like, game join, sign out returns to login. No deprecated Expo packages detected. No SafeAreaView issues (imports from react-native-safe-area-context).

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Likely from a UI component (Modal/Overlay). Non-blocking but should be migrated. Search codebase for pointerEvents= usage.

action_items: Optional: migrate any `pointerEvents` JSX prop to `style={{ pointerEvents: ... }}` to remove RN web deprecation warning (grep for 'pointerEvents=' in components).
No functional issues found — MVP ready for user hand-off.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 791 lines — consider splitting into routers/{auth,facilities,games,marketplace,ai}.py if MVP evolves further (still acceptable for MVP).
AI coach history replay is currently sent as a text prefix rather than reusing LlmChat's internal per-session state — works, but token-inefficient for long sessions.
JWT_SECRET is hard-coded in .env with a demo value — fine for MVP; rotate before prod.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all critical flows: auth, onboarding, 5 tabs, booking, marketplace/checkout, AI Coach, community post+like, game join, sign out)

seed_data_creation: None — server auto-seeds Bangalore/Mumbai facilities, players, coaches, events, tournaments, games, products, community posts on startup. Test users created via OTP flow with unique mobiles.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live in /app/backend/tests/test_kuvira_backend.py (pytest). BASE_URL comes from EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL env var. Auth is mock OTP=123456. All AI/protected routes need Bearer token. For frontend, use mobile viewport 390x844; onboarding is a 4-step wizard (step 0: name+city, step 1: skill, step 2: freq+mode, step 3: goals); use testIDs listed under `data-testid` (login-*, otp-*, onboarding-*, home-*, discover-*, play-*, community-*, profile-*, booking-*, market-*, cart-*, ai-*). AI Coach replies take ~5-15s.
